default_lease_time.description: Default lease duration in seconds for dynamic clients.

max_lease_time.description: Maximum lease duration in seconds for dynamic clients. Note: Man page default is 86400.

use_logging.description: Enable detailed logging of DHCP activity.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., 'daemon', 'local0'–'local7').

domain_name.description: DNS domain name to assign to DHCP clients.

name_servers.description: List of DNS server IP addresses to assign to clients.

subnets.description: List of IPv4 subnets to serve. Each entry defines a network, range, and gateway.

hosts.description: List of static host reservations. Each entry binds a MAC address to a fixed IP.
